headline: Easy breeding chain: Elphidran
title: Easy Elphidran Breeding Chain in Palworld | 3 Steps From Easy Pals | Palworld Breeding Guide
video_script: Here is the easiest way to get Elphidran in Palworld, a friendly dragon you can fly on. Step one: breed Tocotoco with Vanwyrm to get Dazemu. Step two: breed that Dazemu with Leezpunk to get Surfent. Step three: breed Surfent with Grintale, and the egg hatches into Elphidran! Every step is checked against Palworld one point zero breeding data. Put each pair on the Breeding Farm with a cake. Which Pal should I chain next? Comment below!
description: Easy 3-step Palworld 1.0 breeding chain to Elphidran: Tocotoco + Vanwyrm = Dazemu, Dazemu + Leezpunk = Surfent, Surfent + Grintale = Elphidran. Each step verified on PalBreedCalc and with the breeding formula from PinDrop's combi ranks.
